scenicChapters.title: Medellin Las Palmas and Oriente Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2550 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

medellin-las-palmas-and-oriente-loop.story: A 112 km loop that starts and ends near Medellín, about 1 h 48 of riding. It goes by way of Alto de Las Palmas, El Retiro and Guatape. The highest point is about 2,550 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Loos → Belfort met Lakenhal
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-beffroi-de-l-eglise-st-martin-de-.story: 283 km from Cambrai to Cambrai, about 4 h 53 of riding. It crosses from France into Belgium - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.
